task.title: To download the production X-Author for Contracts manifest file

step.cmd: Log in to the Conga Community Portal.
Select Resources and click Install Center.
Under My Packages, click Contract Management.
Scroll toConga X-Author for Contracts, and click Download to download the manifest file.
In the Download File window, click Confirm Download. The manifest file Apttus.XAuthor.App.Production.xml is downloaded.
